shots.headline: Quote it, weigh it, log the profit
shots.sub: All three MeshKit spreadsheets for running a 3D-printing shop in Google Sheets or Excel. Save vs buying individually.

cards.title: 1. 3D Print Pricing Calculator
cards.text: Exact meshkit.pro cost formula, markup or target margin, Etsy/Shopify/eBay fee presets and a 30-row Batch tab.

cards.title: 2. Filament Inventory Tracker
cards.text: Built-in empty-spool tare weights for 14 spool types, gross-minus-tare grams left, LOW flags and Dry Box Log.

cards.title: 3. Print Job Log & Monthly P&L
cards.text: 200 job rows with Queued/Printing/Done/Failed status, honest failure costs and a 24-month profit rollup.

cards.title: Etsy fees built in
cards.text: 6.5% transaction + 3% + $0.25 payment + $0.20 listing, plus an optional 15% offsite-ads toggle per order.

cards.title: Google Sheets & Excel 2016+
cards.text: Formula-only .xlsx files plus Google Sheets copy links. Protected without a password; no macros.

cards.title: Small-business licence
cards.text: Use across your own printers and shop for unlimited quotes and orders. Free updates on Etsy.

shots.headline: 3D Print Pricing Calculator
shots.sub: Material, energy, wear, failure buffer and labour, with single-print Quote and 30-job Batch tabs.

shots.headline: Filament Inventory Tracker
shots.sub: Weigh any spool on a kitchen scale; built-in tare database calculates grams left, % left and stock value.

shots.headline: Print Job Log & Monthly P&L
shots.sub: Every print, every failure and every fee rolled into a 24-month revenue and profit dashboard.

faq.a: Three .xlsx workbooks plus MeshKit-Read-Me-First.zip containing the three Read-Me PDFs and Google Sheets copy links.
Both: Excel 2016+ (Windows/Mac), Microsoft 365, LibreOffice Calc, Numbers and Google Sheets.

faq.q: Can I use this for my Etsy shop?
faq.a: Yes. Personal and small-business use is included; only reselling or redistributing the files themselves is prohibited.

faq.q: Can I change the fee percentages?
faq.a: Yes. Every marketplace fee cell on Settings is an unlocked yellow input.

faq.q: Do I get future tare DB updates?
faq.a: Yes. Re-download updated files from your Etsy purchases page at no extra cost.
